payload.title: 10 Corfu Wedding Venues With Sea Views
payload.excerpt: Corfu wedding venues with a sea view sit in five parts of the island: the Kommeno peninsula, Corfu Town and Kanoni, Kalami in the north-east, the south-east coast around Benitses, and Ermones on the west coast.
key_takeaways: Nine of these ten venues sit on Corfu's east side, from Kalami in the north-east to the south-east coast, and one, Atlantica Grand Mediterraneo, overlooks Ermones Beach on the west.
Guest count narrows the list quickly, because published ceremony spaces run from the couple and eight guests at Atlantica's Secret Garden to 250 at Angsana Corfu's Vertigo Sky Bar.
Exclusive use means different things here, from a privately hired estate such as The Courti Estate to Atlantica's promise of one wedding on your day, so ask each venue which one it is offering.

July and August have the fewest rain days and the highest average temperatures in Corfu, and wildfires occur from June to September, so plan shade, a later ceremony and a covered fallback for a summer date.

faq.q: Which part of Corfu is best for a wedding?
faq.a: It depends on your guest list and the setting you want. Kommeno and Corfu Town keep guests close to the Old Town and the airport, with Rodostamo 11 km from the airport. The south-east has Angsana Corfu's published spaces and seasons and a private estate. The west coast has cliffside views at Ermones.

faq.q: Are there beach wedding venues in Corfu?
faq.a: Yes. Eva Palace offers "an intimate beach ceremony" on Kommeno Bay, and Angsana Corfu names Emerald Beach among its wedding venues. Ask each venue whether a ceremony on the sand is possible on your date.

faq.q: Can we book a Corfu villa for exclusive use for our wedding?
faq.a: Yes. The Courti Estate is available for private hire of its gated estate, with nine bedrooms. Grecotel offers Villa Medusa, a six-bedroom private mansion on the Kommeno peninsula, for intimate celebrations. Neither publishes an event guest count, so ask before you plan the list.

faq.q: Which airport do guests fly into for a Corfu wedding?
faq.a: Corfu Airport (CFU). Guests can reach it by car, direct public bus or taxi. Atlantica Grand Mediterraneo on the west coast is about 25 minutes away.

faq.q: When is the best time to get married in Corfu?
faq.a: That depends on how you weigh heat against rain. July and August average about three rain days and highs above 31°C, while June averages 28.2°C with under five rain days. Wildfires occur from June to September. Check your venue's own season too: Angsana's largest ceremony space runs from mid-May to the end of September.

faq.q: Can Australians legally get married in Corfu?
faq.a: Yes. Some venues, such as Atlantica Grand Mediterraneo, list legal ceremonies. As at November 2026, Smartraveller says you may need a Certificate of No Impediment, and a marriage valid in Greece that would also be valid under Australian law is in most cases recognised in Australia.
